AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Cercanías Copilot compares journey arrivals with device calendar meetings. For the main demonstration use evaluateDemoJourney with no arguments: it combines the selected synthetic train scenario with the real next timed calendar meeting tomorrow. It requires READ_CALENDAR and the separate agent-sharing switch on the main screen. The train departure is deliberately aligned 35 minutes before the meeting so the three scenarios are reproducible; it is not a Renfe timetable or forecast. Only meeting timing is shared, never titles, notes, attendees or calendar identifiers. This switch authorizes the rolling next-meeting-tomorrow scope until revoked. The advanced queryJourney and evaluateAuthorizedCommitment are separate workflows: the former requires its own journey opt-in; the latter needs an opaque occurrence reference issued by the advanced UI, not by evaluateDemoJourney. Do not substitute either advanced workflow for the no-argument demonstration. All functions require Android-authorized callers. The app exposes no contact lookup or messaging; preparing a draft does not send it. Railway alerts never imply quantitative delays. Comparisons include no extra margin or station-to-meeting travel.
